---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for hyper-motion
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem are you trying to solve

Describe the workflow or pain point. "I'm always frustrated when…" works well.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. UI sketches, references to other tools
(Jitter, After Effects, Rive, Framer, etc.), or rough wireframes all help.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about.

## Fit with the architecture

hyper-motion has strong opinions about layout and animation
(see [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md)). Quick check:

- Does this require keyframing absolute coordinates of a child inside an
  auto-layout parent? If yes, please describe the use case — there's
  usually a better way to express it.
- Does this require a runtime dependency we don't already use? Call it
  out so we can discuss the trade-off.

## Additional context

Screenshots, links, anything else.
